purpose: Prospective timestamped market/model observations for line-movement and execution-timing validation. Research observations are not retroactive bets.

earlyLock.note: Eligible for early official recommendation only after normal integrity, price-quality and source-freshness checks.

standardWatch.note: Monitor market and news through the normal execution window.

waitForInformation.note: Do not force early execution when unresolved information can materially move the fair line.
